name: Micora
long_description: Micora re-designed the process of building solar farms to optimize speed to power generation and portability. The product suite combines a palletized solar block, a containerized energy storage system, and low-cost autonomous robots that deploy a solar farm on-site in days to weeks – and pack it back up when needed.
one_liner: Micro-grids in a box deploying industrial power autonomously in weeks

launches.title: Micora: Rapidly deployed industrial micro-grids
launches.tagline: Solar + Battery systems set up with 1/100th of the labor anywhere in the world.
launches.body:

\
The world is facing an unprecedented demand for energy through data centers, electrification across all industries, and broader economic growth. With the newfound demand, the supply of energy continues to lag behind.

For hardware R&D, infrastructure, and manufacturing, these challenges are compounded by the need for more space, pushing development toward remote land with limited infrastructure. Bringing power to these sites remains a bottleneck: large solar projects take years to build, require skilled crews that are already stretched thin, and face lengthy permitting processes. 

**Why Now**

* Electrification is accelerating across all industries (aerospace, logistics, humanoids, etc) and diesel is progressively less viable.
* By 2030, the world will need over 600 GW of new power, but interconnection times are at an all-time high and the industry faces a historic shortage of specialized labor.
* The levelized cost of energy of solar + BESS is now cheaper than grid power across the country.

So we are building rapidly deployed modular power systems in a box for communities and businesses in remote regions that require dependable scaled energy. 

**What it does**

Micora’s end-to-end solution includes site design, installation, and maintenance across the life cycle of the energy system. 

Once a customer orders a Micora system, we deliver a containerized set of robots, solar blocks, and a battery energy storage system on site. Our drone surveys the area, virtually marks the site layout, and kicks off the installation process. The forklift robots kick off a 24/7 schedule of picking and placing solar blocks while continuously hot-swapping batteries till completion. 

Our design enables us to deliver scaled reliable energy at light speed where no one else can.

**Our Ask**

* **We’d like to meet operators of deep tech startups, remote operations, fuel/energy-sensitive operations and underserved regions/communities to better understand your needs.**
* **We’d like to meet other energy generation companies in wind, fuel cells, and even small scale combustion hardware to make our network offering more resilient.**
